title: TikTok Chat
description: A Minecraft plugin that brings TikTok Live Chat messages directly into in-game chat.
body:
# 📱 TikTok Live Chat Integration
A Minecraft plugin for Spigot/Paper servers that seamlessly integrates TikTok Live Chat into your server. Messages sent during a live stream are displayed in real-time directly in the in-game chat, allowing players to interact with live audiences effortlessly.

## ✨ Features
- **Real-time TikTok Live Chat integration**
- **Displays live stream messages in Minecraft chat**
- **Easy configuration and setup**

## 🎮 Use Cases
Perfect for streamers who want to connect their in-game players with their TikTok audience, creating a more interactive and engaging experience.

## ⚙️ Compatibility
- **Bukkit / Purpur / Paper / Spigot servers**
- **Modern Minecraft versions**
